conceptZh: 會是學過、做得到的意思
object: a squad of interlocking building bricks and a lopsided first-try brick pile
morph: the bricks proudly build a silly wrong shape, a lumpy hat, then re-stack it into the roof, stacked windows and base of 會
creativeAngle: 積木小隊先得意地堆出一頂歪歪的帽子，發現不對，聳聳肩一下重排成「會」；先錯再對，詞用「學會」。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale butter-yellow backdrop, locked camera. The only text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 會, centered in saturated emerald-green strokes about 70 percent of frame height, with the little roof 亼 on top, a row of short horizontal bars in the middle, and the small box 曰 below. Cast: a squad of glossy interlocking bricks with dot eyes and tiny stud hats, led by Moxie, an orange 2x3 brick with a confident grin. Moment one, 0 to 1.8s: Moxie claps a stubby top and the squad scurries around, snapping into a tall wobbly pile with a pointy blue brick on top and two crooked red bricks stuck out the sides like ears. The first 會 is spoken as Moxie spreads her studs proudly toward her creation. Moment two, 1.8 to 3.4s: the pile sways and Moxie squints at it, tilts her whole body, looks at the empty outline, then back at her pile, and her grin droops into a flat line. She shrugs with her whole top. The second 會 is spoken as she gives one tiny clap. Moment three, 3.4 to 5.0s: in one quick move the pile pops apart and every brick leaps into place like a zipper closing, the pointy blue brick becomes the roof, the bars stack as three tidy horizontal bricks, and the last two drop into the box at the bottom with a satisfying click, forming the glyph. Moxie hops, spins midair, and lands with a flourish. Moment four, 5.0s onward: a few of the leftover bricks try to peek back into the glyph, but Moxie waves them off to the side. From 5.0 to 8.0s the glyph is perfectly still and uncovered while Moxie and two helpers dance a tiny step and stack into a little three-brick tower at the bottom, never touching the strokes. Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「會、會、學會」, slowly with clear tones as ㄏㄨㄟˋ、ㄏㄨㄟˋ、ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ. First 會 near 0.7s, second near 2.4s, and 學會 around 5.3s as the bricks stack. Stop after the word. Only soft brick clicks, no background music. Soft studio lighting, vivid not neon colors, no flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 會.

conceptZh: 會是「學過就做得到」。小外星人的牽引光束一直抓錯東西，連自己的飛碟都吸起來；大塊頭玩具戰士衝過來揮劍，小外星人只輕輕一戳，戰士像大樹一樣砰地倒下，震得綠色積木排成「會」。最後小外星人終於「學會」用光束，穩穩把泡棉劍吸起來轉圈。
object: a tiny green alien in a toy flying saucer versus a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield, plus a stack of emerald-green foam blocks
morph: the warrior's falling-tree THUMP bounces the green foam blocks into the air and they land stacked as 會: pointed roof 人 over a bar, the middle box with two small ticks, and 曰 at the bottom
creativeAngle: 與前一版的積木隊伍完全不同：改用「大戰小」的實體笑料。笑點來自小外星人光束老是抓錯（連自己都吸起來），卻用一根手指頭戳倒大塊頭戰士，倒地的震動把筆畫排好；「學會」一詞由外星人最後終於正確吸起泡棉劍來演出，聽到的字和看到的畫面是同一件事。
promptEn:
An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale sky-blue backdrop with a soft matte floor, locked camera, soft even studio lighting, bright but not neon. The only text in the whole clip is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 會, which will stand centered in saturated emerald-green foam blocks about 70 percent of frame height with clear margins: a pointed roof 人 on top, a short horizontal bar under it, then a middle square box with two small tick marks inside, and the box 曰 at the bottom. Cast: Pip, a tiny green cartoon alien with big black eyes and one antenna, piloting a palm-sized silver toy flying saucer that hums; and Brawnie, a huge chunky plastic toy warrior with a round red shield, a floppy foam sword and a goofy overconfident grin. On the floor at center sits a tidy pile of emerald-green foam blocks.

Moment one, 0 to 1.6s: Brawnie fills the right side of frame, puffs out his chest, bangs the foam sword on his shield twice and points it at Pip, who hovers small at left. Pip blinks, narrows his eyes, and aims his saucer's glowing teal tractor beam at the sword. The first 會 is spoken at about 0.6s as Brawnie flexes.

Moment two, 1.6 to 3.3s: Brawnie charges left with heavy stomping steps. Pip fires the tractor beam, but it misses the sword and grabs his own saucer instead, hoisting it up and flipping it upside down so Pip dangles by his seatbelt, eyes wide, arms waving. He bonks the beam button and drops back down with a wobble just as Brawnie arrives swinging.

Moment three, 3.3 to 4.9s: a frozen half-beat with Brawnie mid-swing, cheeks puffed. Pip simply tilts the saucer aside and pokes Brawnie's shield with one tiny green finger. The overswing spins Brawnie around twice, he teeters stiff as a tree, and topples forward with a big soft THUMP, landing belly-down across the bottom-left corner. The thump bounces the green foam blocks into the air and they drop back stacked as the glyph 會, click-click, perfectly formed and centered. The second 會 is spoken at about 4.6s exactly as the last block clicks into 曰.

Moment four, 4.9 to 8.0s: the glyph 會 stays completely still, uncovered and readable for the final three seconds. Brawnie lies dazed in the bottom-left margin with swirly eyes and a sheepish grin, never touching the strokes. Pip lands his saucer on Brawnie's back in a tiny arms-up victory pose, then aims the tractor beam once more and this time cleanly lifts the foam sword, twirling it proudly in the air at bottom-left. The word 學會 is spoken at about 5.6s exactly as the sword rises in the beam. Brawnie gives a thumbs-up from the floor.

Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「會、會、學會」, read slowly and distinctly with clear tones as ㄏㄨㄟˋ、ㄏㄨㄟˋ、ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ, first 會 near 0.6s, second near 4.6s, 學會 near 5.6s, and then stops. Only a soft saucer hum, light foam thumps and block clicks, no background music louder than the voice. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no flashing, no lens flare, and no writing other than the single glyph 會.
